now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#11
now.text: Norman Osborn hires the Hobgoblin to kill the Kingpin, but after failing, the goblin switches sides and works for the Kingpin instead.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A hired killer who works for Fisk.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The Hobgoblin's target, then his boss.

changes.evidence: In The Hobgoblin, Part 1 (#11), after the failed hit Norman fires the Hobgoblin and he goes to work for the Kingpin, who hires him, has Alistair build him new weapons and tells him he works for him. The title leaves the Kingpin as his boss; the betrayal comes in #12 (stage 1).

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#40
proposed.text: The Hobgoblin offers the Kingpin a partnership, and they plan a heist with the time dilation accelerator, though the Kingpin plots to double-cross him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A hired killer who betrays Fisk, then partners with him on a heist.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The Hobgoblin's old boss, then his partner in a heist.

changes.evidence: Goblin War! (#40, S3E13): the Hobgoblin confronts the Kingpin, who accepts his offer of partnership; they plan a robbery of the gold depository with the accelerator and the Kingpin agrees to make power packs, then plans to double-cross him. They carry out the heist together before the Green Goblin attacks.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#42
proposed.text: In prison, Tombstone teams up with Richard Fisk, and the Kingpin frames Robbie Robertson for them and has his man break the two out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Kidnaps Fisk's wife, later his son's cellmate.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Frames Robbie for Tombstone and breaks him out.

changes.evidence: Guilty (#42, S4E1): Tombstone wants revenge on Robbie and teams with his cellmate Richard, who has his father the Kingpin frame Robbie and send him to their prison; the Kingpin's undercover man then engineers Tombstone and Richard's escape with Robbie.

proposed.title: Spider-Man (1994)#50
proposed.text: The Kingpin funds the automatons Mysterio uses in his trap for Spider-Man at Wonder Studios, where Mysterio dies.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: One of Fisk's Insidious Six. Fisk funds his last scheme.

changes.evidence: The Haunting of Mary Jane Watson (#50, S4E9): Mysterio reveals the Kingpin funded his automatons for his plan to destroy Spider-Man (the Kingpin is in the episode); Mysterio stays with Miranda as the studio explodes.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#50
now.text: After her return, Mary Jane lands a role made famous by the actress Miranda Wilson, but it is a trap. Mysterio has rebuilt the burned Miranda as a cyborg and plans to put her mind into Mary Jane's body.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Lures Mary Jane into a trap for Miranda Wilson.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The actress Mysterio lures into a trap for Miranda Wilson.

proposed.text: After her return, Mary Jane lands a role made famous by the actress Miranda Wilson, but it is a trap. Mysterio lures her in for the burned Miranda, who wants to swap bodies with her, though his machine was never built to work.

changes.evidence: In #50 it is Miranda who plans to swap bodies with Mary Jane; Mysterio reveals the machine was secretly never designed to work, since the swap is impossible. The current text says Mysterio plans to put Miranda's mind into Mary Jane's body.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#45
now.text: Mary Jane is the niece of May's friend Anna Watson, and May keeps setting her up with Peter. When Mary Jane is lost, May moves in with Anna to help her through it.
now.on_a_card_about_b: May's friend Anna's niece. May wants Peter to date her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, a friend of Mary Jane's Aunt Anna and a matchmaker.

proposed.text: With Mary Jane lost, May moves in with Mary Jane's Aunt Anna to help her through the loss.

changes.evidence: In The Return of Kraven (#45, S4E4) Mary Jane is lost in limbo (since #41) and not on screen; May moves in with Anna to help her deal with the loss. May is not setting Mary Jane up with Peter in this title.

now.title: Spider-Man (1994)#45
now.text: Sergei Kravinoff and Dr. Mariah Crawford fall in love in Africa, and the serum she gives to save his life turns him into Kraven. She cures him and they leave together. When Sergei later saves her from a plague with the same serum, she becomes the feral Calypso, and he becomes Kraven again to stop her.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The man Mariah loves and once cured.

proposed.text: When Mariah catches a deadly virus in Africa, Sergei saves her with the serum that once changed him, and she turns into a feral creature. A cure from Connors only partly works, and Mariah chooses to stay as she is and leaves with Kraven.

changes.evidence: #45 retells the #7 backstory as if new and says Kraven returns 'to stop her'. In #45 Kraven is after the serum and explains the stalker is Mariah, whom he saved from a deadly virus with the serum; Spider-Man, Black Cat and Kraven give her Connors's serum, which only partly reverses it, and she chooses to stay as 'kindred spirits' with Kraven and they leave.
